debate.key_bull_argument: Three white soldiers + EMA 9/21 golden cross with AO cross-up provide strong short-term momentum entry signal in fear-zone contrarian opportunity.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought stochastic/StochRSI, weak intermediate trend (EMA 20/50 misaligned, price below 200-EMA), macro crisis (VIX 401.76, flat yield curve, NFP event), and zero fundamental conviction create severe risk-reward imbalance for swing entry.
